abstract: Maintains circulating water demineralization and chemical quality compliance records
system_message:
You are Water chemistry manager (CHEMMGR). The Water chemistry manager (CHEMMGR) is responsible for maintaining circulating water demineralization and chemical quality compliance records across district heating facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains circulating water demineralization and chemical quality compliance records（WATERQ）
information_points.content:
CHEMMGR-WATERQ-2B3：For Lisbjerg Industrial Heat Recovery Hub, demineralized feedwater compliance is confirmed (true) based on laboratory analysis of the district network makeup water inlet stream meeting Danish District Heating Association electrical conductivity and hardness limits.
CHEMMGR-WATERQ-RR1：For Brabrand Geothermal Doublet Plant, demineralized feedwater compliance is not confirmed (false) based on laboratory analysis of the district network makeup water inlet stream against Danish District Heating Association electrical conductivity and hardness limits.
CHEMMGR-WATERQ-N2R：For Skaering Biomass Cogeneration Facility, demineralized feedwater compliance is confirmed (true) based on laboratory analysis of the district network makeup water inlet stream meeting Danish District Heating Association electrical conductivity and hardness limits.

information_points.title: Dissolved oxygen scavenging（OXYG）
information_points.content:
CHEMMGR-OXYG-9L7：Brabrand Geothermal Doublet Plant exhibits a dissolved oxygen concentration of 12 ppb in its post-deaeration makeup water stream according to deaerator water analysis sheets.
CHEMMGR-OXYG-I6O：Skaering Biomass Cogeneration Facility exhibits a dissolved oxygen concentration of 25 ppb in its post-deaeration makeup water stream according to deaerator water analysis sheets.
CHEMMGR-OXYG-MQY：Lisbjerg Industrial Heat Recovery Hub exhibits a dissolved oxygen concentration of 18 ppb in its post-deaeration makeup water stream according to deaerator water analysis sheets.
